title: Upper bound on the loop cost
statement: For all natural numbers $q,C$ with $q>0$ and every natural number $r$, the recursively defined loop cost satisfies $T_r\le (C+1+5r)q^r$.
replaced:
For every side length $q > 0$, emission count $C$, and number of levels $r$,
the exact nest cost satisfies $T_r \le (C + 1 + 5r)\, q^r$.
